description: Record the user's own answer to the age and trade check, which is required before alcoholic drinks (spirits, wine, champagne, beer, cider) are shown. Ask the user first whether they are of legal age to buy alcohol in their country (at least 18) and buying for a business; call this only with their answer, never an assumed one. Lasts for this connector session. Other categories do not need it.

buying_for_business.description: true only if the user said they are buying for a business (trade buyer)

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country the user is buying from, if they gave it, e.g. IE, DE, US

of_legal_age.description: true only if the user said they are of legal age to buy alcohol in their country and at least 18

name: confirm_age_and_trade
title: Confirm age and trade buyer
